source: TypeCheckTestCase subclass (test/com/google/javascript/jscomp/TypeCheckTest.java, commit 48f4107ca): no getProcessor, no overridden harness hooks, no instance fields; records replay through ReplayTypeCheckTest; there is no processor. The instance compiler is built by CompilerTypeTestCase.setUp/initializeNewCompiler (new Compiler(), initOptions(getDefaultOptions()), markFeatureNotAllowed(MODULES)), which the type_check replay path models; newTestLegacy() wraps that instance compiler, newTest() builds a fresh one.

Compiler.forwardDeclaredTypes is a LinkedHashSet shared by reference with the JSTypeRegistry, so adding after initOptions (as setUp then the test body do) is equivalent.
